About D365 Mastery

Hi, I'm Manu Sharma, a Principal Technical Architect with deep roots in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations. I founded D365 Mastery to bridge the gap between business requirements and scalable, performant ERP architecture.

Connect on LinkedIn

My Philosophy

I believe that a successful Dynamics 365 implementation is not just about writing code; it's about understanding the core business processes. A poor architectural decision on day one can cost millions in performance tuning and technical debt down the road.

Why D365 Mastery?

  • No Junior Devs: We don't bait-and-switch. You work directly with Senior Architects.
  • Performance First: Every customization is reviewed for SQL deadlocks, batch bottlenecks, and overall system health.
  • Standard Over Custom: We push back on unnecessary customizations, leveraging ISVs and standard features to keep you in the "One Version" track.

Need a Senior Architect on your team?

Let's ensure your D365 F&O project succeeds with a robust architectural foundation.
